_about: orbiter's curated defaults for its build suggestions (src/lib/core/builds/suggest.ts): each warframe's main role(s), from how the community plays it, not from DE. One line per frame on why. Primes and Umbra use the base frame's line. Roles: tank (health, armour, damage reduction), strength (abilities that scale with Ability Strength), range (crowd control over an area), efficiency (support, keeps abilities up). Flags: spam = casts a lot, so energy mods matter; duration = the kit leans on Ability Duration; knockdown = no innate protection while it fights up close, so Primed Sure Footed in the exilus at the high tier; shields = plays on shields, not health; noEnergy = its abilities don't use energy; guess = a newer frame orbiter knows only from its ability text. augment = an augment most builds for it carry.

Ash.why: Bladestorm's damage scales with strength and it eats energy.

Atlas.why: Landslide and Rumblers scale with strength; Petrify and his rubble armour keep him standing.

Banshee.why: Sound Quake and Sonar want strength and range, and channelling her 4 drains energy where enemies reach her.

Baruuk.why: Restraint, Elude and Serene Storm make him a damage-reduction tank whose fists scale with strength.

Caliban.why: Razorgyre and Lethal Progeny are cast often and scale with strength and range.

Chroma.why: Vex Armor and Elemental Ward are strength buffs that need to stay up.

Citrine.why: Prismatic Gem and Preserving Shell are long-lasting support pieces.

Cyte-09.why: His kit feeds your guns (scans, ammo, the Neutralizer); keep it up cheaply.

Dagath.why: Grave Spirit and her doom effects scale with strength and need duration.

Dante.why: Light Verse's Overguard and the Final Verse scale with strength, and he writes verses all the time.

Ember.why: Inferno and Fire Blast's armour strip want strength and range, cast often in the middle of the fight.

Equinox.why: Mend & Maim builds range and strength while channelled up close.

Excalibur.why: Exalted Blade is a strength-scaled channel that drains energy; Chromatic Blade adds an element to it.

Follie.why: Inkblot and Plein Air are area crowd control; Self Portrait soaks damage.

Frost.why: Snow Globe's health and Avalanche scale with strength and range.

Gara.why: Splinter Storm and Mass Vitrify want strength, range and duration.

Garuda.why: Seeking Talons and Dread Mirror scale with strength; she fights up close.

Gauss.why: Redline and Kinetic Plating want strength and duration; Thermal Transfer buffs the squad's elements.

Grendel.why: Nourish and Feast make him a health-and-armour tank.

Gyre.why: Her arcs and Cathode Grace reward strength and range and are cast a lot.

Harrow.why: Thurible, Penance and Covenant are support buffs; Condemn's overshields matter more than health.

Hildryn.why: Her abilities spend shields, not energy, so shield capacity is both her tank and her mana.

Hydroid.why: Tentacle Swarm is area control; Pilfering Swarm is the loot build most players run.

Inaros.why: A huge health pool that refills with Devour and Desiccation.

Ivara.why: Prowl, Quiver and Navigator are drains and timers: duration and efficiency.

Jade.why: Symphony Of Mercy and Glory On High scale with strength; she spends energy in the air.

Khora.why: Whipclaw spam and Strangledome scale with strength and range; Pilfering Strangledome is her common loot build.

Koumei.why: Kumihimo and Bunraku are area status effects; Omamori charms keep her alive.

Kullervo.why: Wrathful Advance and Storm of Ukko want strength and range; he fights in melee range.

Lavos.why: His abilities run on cooldowns, not energy, and scale with strength and range.

Limbo.why: Cataclysm and Stasis are area control that must last.

Loki.why: Invisibility and Radial Disarm are utility: duration and efficiency, not damage.

Mag.why: Magnetize and Polarize scale with strength and range and are cast in the thick of it.

Mesa.why: Peacemaker is a strength-scaled channel; Shatter Shield's reduction also scales with strength.

Mirage.why: Eclipse's damage bonus scales with strength and has to stay up; Total Eclipse shares it.

Narin.why: Cold abilities that spread over an area, with shields and Overguard to stay in.

Nekros.why: Desecrate is a range-and-loot ability; Despoil pays for it with health.

Nezha.why: Warding Halo's protection scales with strength.

Nidus.why: Mutation stacks and Parasitic Link make him a tank whose Ravenous scales with strength.

Nokko.why: Mushrooms that buff strength and give energy; a support-damage mix.

Nova.why: Molecular Prime covers the map with range; many players lower strength on purpose to speed enemies up.

Nyx.why: Chaos is area control that wants range and duration.

Oberon.why: Renewal and Hallowed Ground are support that scales with strength.

Octavia.why: Mallet and Metronome want duration and range more than anything.

Oraxia.why: Webbed Embrace and Widow's Brood are area control with toxin damage.

Orion & Sirius.why: Event Horizon and Celestial Clash are area damage; swapping halves refunds efficiency.

Sirius & Orion.why: Jade Stars and Light's Sanctuary are area damage and support; swapping halves refunds efficiency.

Protea.why: Grenade Fan and Blaze Artillery are cast often and scale with strength.

Qorvex.why: Huge armour and Disometric Guard's status immunity; his radiation scales with strength.

Revenant.why: Mesmer Skin charges and Danse Macabre scale with strength, and the beam drains energy.

Rhino.why: Iron Skin and Roar both scale with strength; Ironclad Charge adds armour to Iron Skin.

Saryn.why: Spores and Miasma spread over an area and scale with strength; she recasts constantly.

Sevagoth.why: Gloom and Reap scale with strength and range.

Styanax.why: Final Stand and Tharros Strike scale with strength and range.

Temple.why: Heat abilities on a beat; Backbeat timing already refunds efficiency.

Titania.why: Razorwing is a strength-scaled channel; Razorwing Blitz is near-universal on her.

Trinity.why: Energy Vampire and Blessing are support that scales with strength; Abating Link strips armour.

Uriel.why: Demons he heals and resurrects; Infernalis and Brimstone are area heat damage.

Valkyr.why: Hysteria makes her invulnerable while it drains energy; Warcry scales with strength and Eternal War extends it.

Vauban.why: Bastille and Photon Strike are area control cast over and over.

Volt.why: Discharge and Electric Shield scale with strength and range.

Voruna.why: Her wolves' buffs scale with strength; she swaps between them all the time.

Wukong.why: Defy, Cloud Walker and the Twin make him hard to kill; the Twin scales with strength.

Xaku.why: The Lost and Grasp of Lohk want strength and range.

Yareli.why: Sea Snares and Aquablades scale with strength and range.

Zephyr.why: Turbulence and Tornado want duration, range and strength.
